events.title: Earnings Estimates Rising for SM Energy (SM): Will It Gain?
events.body: SM Energy (SM) shares have started gaining and might continue moving higher in the near term, as indicated by solid earnings estimate revisions.

events.title: SM Energy Q1 Earnings Beat on Higher Oil-Equivalent Production
